Office Hours | Software Engineer (all levels) | SF, NYC, or Remote (US) | https://officehours.com We connect organizations (AI labs, startups, investors, consulting firms) with experts for paid calls, surveys, and model training. We're profitable and growing quickly.

Stack: TypeScript, Node, Postgres, OpenSearch, Temporal | React, Next.js, Tailwind | AWS
